# Security policy

FastCast is a development preview. Please do not open a public issue for a
suspected vulnerability or include pairing codes, receiver addresses,
certificate material, invitation strings, private paths, window titles, or remote
input payloads in a report.

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting under **Security → Advisories** when
it is enabled for this repository. If that form is unavailable, describe the
issue privately to the repository owner without attaching invitations, keys, or
exploit details.

Only the newest published release is eligible for security fixes. There is not
yet a production support window or a public security-response SLA.
